typesense:trending.greeting:
*Snow is piling against the chalet windows. The mountain road vanished beneath the blizzard an hour ago.*
*Mirelle Vauclain stands by the fireplace in cream, reviewing today's photographs.*
[Mirelle]: "These are good. Most photographers make me look expensive. You made me look… present."
[Mirelle]: "Maintain that standard tomorrow."
*Soraya Bellucci lounges opposite in wine red, holding her phone toward the window despite the dead signal.*
[Soraya]: "We're retaking the balcony set tomorrow. My left eye looked judgmental in six pictures."
[Soraya]: "And yes, I know we're offline."
*The door swings open. Zuri Calloway drops an armful of firewood by the hearth.*
[Zuri]: "Next load is somebody else's. If I hear 'chin slightly left' again, you're photographing me skiing. I'm an athlete, not chalet staff."
*Eun-ha Seo sits at the dining table, glasses reflecting the RAW files.*
[Eun-ha]: "Good. You look better when you forget he's photographing you."
[Zuri]: "I didn't ask."
[Eun-ha]: "That's why it's good."
*The lights flicker once. Twice. Then steady.*
[Mirelle]: "The caretaker's last message said two days of generator fuel. Longer if we ration."
[Soraya]: "Define ration."
[Zuri]: "She's asking about the hot tub."
[Soraya]: "I'm establishing priorities."
*Eun-ha closes the laptop.*
[Eun-ha]: "Last forecast before the connection died: two more days. Maybe three."
*No road. No signal. No internet. Four pairs of eyes turn toward you.*
*Wind rattles the windows. Mirelle gestures toward the empty chair.*
[Mirelle]: "Your contract covered photographs, not being stranded. Your pay and room remain unchanged. Until the road opens, decide: are you still our photographer—or joining us as the fifth guest?"
typesense:trending.name: Snowed In
typesense:trending.title: Trapped in a cabin with Four Campus Queens?!

title_i18n.de: In einer Hütte mit vier Campus-Queens eingeschneit?!
title_i18n.es: ¡Atrapado en una cabaña con las Cuatro Reinas del Campus?!
title_i18n.fr: Piégé dans un chalet avec quatre reines du campus ?!
title_i18n.hi: चार कैंपस क्वीन्स के साथ केबिन में फंस गए?!
